headline_marked: [[14 injured]] in Jubo Dal-Chhatra Dal clashes in Dhaka's New Market
headline: 14 injured in Jubo Dal-Chhatra Dal clashes in Dhaka's New Market
summary: Clashes erupted in Dhaka's New Market area on Tuesday evening, injuring at least 14 people from Jubo Dal and Dhaka College Chhatra Dal. The conflict reportedly stemmed from alleged extortion from footpath vendors and control over the area.
details: At least 14 people were injured in violent clashes between activists of Jubo Dal's New Market unit and Dhaka College Chhatra Dal members. The incident occurred in Dhaka's New Market area on Tuesday evening.
The clashes broke out around 7:30 PM near Balaka Cinema Hall. Witnesses and injured individuals reported the conflict stemmed from alleged extortion from footpath vendors and control of the area.

The incident began when Jubo Dal activists reportedly came to collect money from footpath vendors, which Dhaka College Chhatra Dal members resisted. An altercation ensued, during which several students were assaulted.
According to the injured, a group of 40-50 people led by local Jubo Dal leaders later attacked Dhaka College Chhatra Dal members with sticks and knives. This escalated the violence significantly.

After news of the initial attack spread, Dhaka College students and Chhatra Dal activists went to Bashundhara Goli near Priyangan Market, where a second clash erupted. Vandalism, attacks, and counter-attacks followed, creating panic in the area.

Eight injured from the Dhaka College side and six from the Jubo Dal side were identified, including leaders from both groups. All 14 initially received treatment at Popular Hospital, with several later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).

DMCH Police Camp In-charge Inspector Md Faruk confirmed the injured were receiving treatment at the emergency department, noting the number might increase. Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam stated the situation was under control by 11:30 PM, and police would investigate and take legal action.

headline: OC and 4 others injured as police team attacked during investigation
summary: A police team, including the Officer-in-Charge, was assaulted while conducting an investigation. This incident resulted in injuries to five individuals.
details: A police team, including the Officer-in-Charge (OC), was attacked while conducting an investigation. This incident resulted in injuries to five members of the team.
The officers were reportedly assaulted during their duties. The OC was confirmed to be among the five individuals who sustained injuries.
